physical_skill: Place a six-leg elastomer spider fully into the three jaws of a fixed industrial motor hub, turn the freely rotating keyed hub on a second shaft until its jaws find the spider gaps, slide it to an 18 mm catalogue gap, release both hubs, and verify engagement and rest.
valid_shortcuts: Either hub may be approached first, the spider may be oriented by any equivalent rotation that puts its legs between the fixed jaws, and the loose hub may be turned in either direction to find mesh. Setting only the gap without spider engagement does not score; holding a part earns at most partial credit; full credit requires all components released and stable.
